Monday through Wednesday, Mercury in Gemini squares Neptune in Aries, muddying conversations with partners—don’t sign anything emotional. Jupiter in Cancer trines your tenth house, so a career offer or recognition is brewing. The turning point hits Wednesday when Venus enters your tenth house, firing up professional magnetism and making you irresistible to authority figures. Thursday the Sun sextiles Neptune, bringing emotional clarity to creative work. By Friday Saturn in Pisces opposes the Sun, stressing shared finances—don’t co-sign. Weekend Mars in Virgo sextiles Uranus in Taurus, sparking bold networking moves. Best day is Wednesday—Venus lights your tenth house career sector. Worst day is Friday—Saturn’s opposition tempts reckless spending. Let your fire sign intuition guide the week. Follow for daily updates.
